news.headline: Microsoft Stocks Move Lower as $1 Billion Anthropic Bet Precedes Ignite
news.summary: Microsoft is one of seven cornerstone buyers in Anthropic's IPO placement, a day before its biggest annual product event opens in San Francisco.

news.headline: ServiceNow vs. Palantir Technologies: Comparing Steady Sales Scale Against Rapid Revenue Acceleration
news.summary: Palantir's quarterly revenue has more than quadrupled in two years, narrowing the gap with ServiceNow's far larger base at a pace the rival cannot match.

news.headline: Alphabet Stocks Decline 3.1% as $10 Billion Anthropic Buy Lifts Stake Before IPO
news.summary: Google is buying 135 million Anthropic shares alongside the IPO, deepening a holding worth well over $100 billion at the midpoint price.

news.headline: Altimeter Capital to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO - report
news.summary: Investing.com -- Altimeter Capital will invest $5 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering, according to Brad Gerstner, who spoke on CNBC's "Halftime Report" on Monday.
